summary: Established that the frozen search couples next-disc and reveal randomness to a single sample index, so at seven strata every marginal is exact but the joint covers only seven of forty-nine outcomes; factored the chance node into disc-samples by reveal-samples and showed chance-node decorrelation is exchangeable with search depth.
validationPerformed: CHECK gate: decision-identical and work-identical to the frozen reference and to the single-knob arms, 0 mismatches; end-to-end 64-game artifact identity against previously recorded arms including total logical work.
Work bounds computed per configuration and verified never to bind across 30,865 decisions.
limitations: Recorded by the coordinator on the delegated agent's behalf; the agent had no write access to research/ and did not review this transcription.
Exploratory namespace only; does not upgrade docs/research/ or any frozen protocol.
64 paired games per arm; individual reveal-sample steps are inside noise and the claim rests on a monotone ordering plus significant endpoint tests.
Two arms were left unfinished: depth 4 with two reveal samples, and the hundred-percent-coverage endpoint.
